segments.text:
V. 23.
Jeſus anſwered—Becauſe ye love and obey me, and they do not, therefore I will reveal myſelf to you, and not to them. My Father will love him—The more any Man loves and obeys, the more GOD will love him. And we will come to him, and make our abode with him—Which implies ſuch a large Manifeſtation of the divine Preſence and Love, that the former in Juſtification, is as Nothing in Compariſon of it.
